title: Painting a Scene in Prose
grammar: Converting relative clauses (aki/amely) into compact pre-nominal participial phrases
goal: I can read and appreciate Gyula Krúdy's 'A vörös postakocsi' in adapted B2 prose.
I can transform post-nominal relative clauses ('aki...', 'amely...') into compact B2 pre-nominal participial modifiers.
I can write a complete atmospheric paragraph combining active and passive participial modifiers.
